sentences.text: A range is a pair of fixed marks, the front one lower and closer, the rear one higher and farther away, placed so that when they line up you’re on the centerline of a channel.
Range dayboards are rectangular, often with a vertical stripe, and they may be lighted.
If the rear mark appears to the right of the front mark, you’re left of the centerline, so steer right until they line up again.
Ranges are also excellent for checking your compass, because the chart gives the range line’s true direction.
Only follow a range within the charted channel, since the line can extend beyond safe water.
